//go:build linux && (amd64 || arm64)

package text

import (
	"golang.org/x/image/font/gofont/gomono"
	"math"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func orbitFractionalSystem(t *testing.T) *System {
	t.Helper()
	s := newSystem()
	e, err := newPango()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.eng = e
	if err = e.register(gomono.TTF, "Orbit Mono"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return s
}
func TestOrbitFractionalLayoutLocal(t *testing.T) {
	s := orbitFractionalSystem(t)
	p := Params{Text: "Untracked fixture note.", Style: Style{Family: "Orbit Mono", Size: 12.5}}
	normal := s.Shape(p)
	p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = true
	fraction := s.Shape(p)
	if fraction.Width >= normal.Width || fraction.Height != normal.Height {
		t.Fatalf("width/metrics normal=%gx%g fractional=%gx%g", normal.Width, normal.Height, fraction.Width, fraction.Height)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
		p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = i%2 == 0
		l := s.Shape(p)
		want := normal.Width
		if p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions {
			want = fraction.Width
		}
		if l.Width != want {
			t.Fatal("policy/cache contamination", i, l.Width, want)
		}
	}
	p.Width = (normal.Width + fraction.Width) / 2
	p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = false
	if len(s.Shape(p).Lines) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("default should wrap")
	}
	p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = true
	if len(s.Shape(p).Lines) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("fraction should fit")
	}
	t.Logf("normal=%gx%g fractional=%gx%g", normal.Width, normal.Height, fraction.Width, fraction.Height)
}
func TestOrbitFractionalFontOptionsAndMixedCaret(t *testing.T) {
	s := orbitFractionalSystem(t)
	for _, setting := range []string{"none", "slight", "full"} {
		s.SetFontRendering("gray", setting, "rgb")
		for _, v := range []string{"plain \t spaces  ", "AV fi é 中文🙂 العربية", strings.Repeat("longword ", 80)} {
			for _, on := range []bool{false, true} {
				p := Params{Text: v, Width: 178, Style: Style{Family: "Orbit Mono", Size: 12.5, OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions: on}}
				l := s.Shape(p)
				if len(l.Lines) == 0 || math.IsNaN(float64(l.Width)) {
					t.Fatal("invalid layout")
				}
				for i := 0; i <= len([]rune(v)); i++ {
					x, y, h := l.CaretAt(CaretPosition{Index: i})
					q := l.PositionAt(x, y+h/2)
					if q.Index < 0 || q.Index > len([]rune(v)) {
						t.Fatal("invalid hit", q)
					}
				}
				for _, r := range l.SelectionRanges(CaretPosition{}, CaretPosition{Index: len([]rune(v))}) {
					if r.End < r.Start || r.Start < 0 || r.End > len([]rune(v)) {
						t.Fatal("negative selection")
					}
				}
			}
		}
		p := Params{Text: "123456789", Style: Style{Family: "Orbit Mono", Size: 12.5}}
		a := s.Shape(p)
		p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = true
		b := s.Shape(p)
		p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = false
		c := s.Shape(p)
		if a.Width != c.Width || a.Height != b.Height {
			t.Fatal("options update changed default or metrics")
		}
	}
}

func TestOrbitFractionalBoundedContextsAndLatinCaret(t *testing.T) {
	s := orbitFractionalSystem(t)
	e := s.eng.(*pangoEngine)
	p := Params{Text: "0123456789 ABC xyz", Style: Style{Family: "Orbit Mono", Size: 12.5, OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions: true}}
	l := s.Shape(p)
	count := len(e.fonts)
	for i := 0; i <= len(p.Text); i++ {
		x, y, h := l.CaretAt(CaretPosition{Index: i})
		q := l.PositionAt(x, y+h/2)
		if q.Index != i {
			t.Fatalf("caret roundtrip at%d ->%v", i, q)
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < 300; i++ {
		p.Width = float32(100 + i%100)
		s.Shape(p)
	}
	if len(e.fonts) > count+1 {
		t.Fatalf("owned contexts created unbounded fonts %d->%d", count, len(e.fonts))
	}
}

func TestOrbitFractionalMissingNativeAPIFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	s := orbitFractionalSystem(t)
	e := s.eng.(*pangoEngine)
	if !s.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable() {
		t.Fatal("expected pinned capability")
	}
	old := pangoLib.contextSetRoundPositions
	pangoLib.contextSetRoundPositions = nil
	if s.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable() {
		t.Fatal("missing API reported available")
	}
	defer func() {
		pangoLib.contextSetRoundPositions = old
		if recover() == nil {
			t.Fatal("opt-in silently accepted missing Pango API")
		}
	}()
	e.shape([]rune("text"), Style{OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions: true}, nil, 0, false, false)
}
